scope: apps/mobile source and Android Expo Go native UI

findings.title: Shared controls fall below Android target size
findings.issue: At density420 (2.625px/dp), header theme/bell/account are79×84px≈30×32dp and back68×84px≈26×32dp. Fields, filter chips and primary buttons are40dp; SelectField rows/scanner close/grid tabs44dp; picker close≈20×20dp; ActionDialog close36×36dp. No hitSlop compensates these boxes.
findings.recommendedFix: Set shared input/button/chip minima to48dp, expand close controls, and reflow the header at narrow widths so target enlargement does not overlap neighbors.
acceptanceCriteria: Android hierarchy/hit-region measurement reports ≥48dp on both axes for every actionable control.
No target overlaps after enlarging it; 320dp/150% type remains usable.

findings.title: Semantic colors produce failing text contrast
findings.issue: Rendered exact-color pixels confirm dark logout white on#FB7185=2.6914:1, failing even3:1. Light success badge#059669/#ECFDF5=3.5771 and light readiness warning#D97706/#FFFBEB=3.0721 fail normal text4.5:1. These labels are9–13sp, below large-text thresholds. Body text passes17.85light/15.55dark.

evidence.observed: White label1234 exact pixels; pink fill92506 exact pixels;2.6914 ratio.
Success987 fg/8112 bg exact pixels;3.5771 ratio.
Warning2102 fg/17285 bg exact pixels;3.0721 ratio.

findings.recommendedFix: Separate semantic foreground colors from filled-button colors. Use a darker danger fill with white button text and darker light-theme success/warning text tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-measure exact rendered pairs in both themes: all normal labels≥4.5:1.
Verify semantic text, destructive confirmation labels and status badges separately.

findings.criterion: Authenticated permission denial offers a recoverable exit
findings.title: No authorized tabs leaves the session without an account exit
findings.issue: MainTabNavigator returns a bare ForbiddenScreen when tabs are empty. ForbiddenScreen contains only text and has no AppHeader/account/logout button. RootNavigator still renders authenticated Main rather than Login. An authenticated account lacking all mobile tab permissions cannot switch accounts through this screen.

evidence.observed: No buttons or navigation actions rendered.

findings.recommendedFix: Provide an account/controlled logout action on the permission fallback and explain how to request access.
acceptanceCriteria: Use an existing authorized zero-tab account: fallback provides a reachable Account action.
User can review role and cancel/confirm logout without clearing app storage manually.

findings.title: Dense header and field actions invite adjacent mis-taps
findings.issue: Header action gaps are4dp (10–11px at420dpi); Gate-In search/scan and survey severity targets are separated by6dp (≈16px). These are below the requested8dp separation.
findings.recommendedFix: Use spacing.sm (8dp) for adjacent independent controls and preserve it when targets grow.
acceptanceCriteria: Measured external gaps are≥8dp in native screenshots/hierarchy.
320dp layout reflows without reducing target sizes or spacing.

findings.criterion: 320dp width and150% font scaling preserve content and controls
findings.title: Large type on a narrow screen clips the role and spills the gate icon
findings.issue: At840×1680px/420dpi (320×640dp) with fontScale1.5, ADMIN becomes an unreadable narrow sliver overlapping the theme action, and the selected Gate-In truck icon spills outside its segment. Body fields remain scrollable. The fixed header action row and unconstrained GateModeSwitch text cause the crowding.

evidence.observed: Gate-In segment[50,609][412,714]; visible icon extends left of segment.

findings.recommendedFix: Give header information and action controls separate rows on narrow/scaled layouts; constrain/wrap segment labels within flex:1 and let the segments grow vertically.
findings.fixSnippet:
<View style={{ flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }} />
// Within each segment:
<Text style={{ flex: 1, flexShrink: 1, textAlign: 'center' }}>{label}</Text>
acceptanceCriteria: At320dp width and150% type, full role is readable and no icon/text crosses its target.
All tab labels remain distinguishable; inspect at200% separately.

findings.criterion: Business labels use comprehensible localized wording
findings.title: Raw enums and mixed language leak into operational screens
findings.issue: Native lookup/detail show IN_YARD, SIZE_40 and DRY; yard operation rows show COMPLETED/CANCELLED/INSPECTION; confirmations show DAMAGE_SURVEY and STRIPPING despite localized chooser labels. Notifications contain English titles/body in otherwise Vietnamese chrome. This increases interpretation effort at review time.

evidence.observed: Container QATU2282957 Gate-Out Completed; English body.

findings.recommendedFix: Use shared localized display maps for statuses/types and notification templates while preserving stored API codes.
acceptanceCriteria: Each currently observed enum renders a Vietnamese business label on list/detail/confirmation screens.
Known backend English notification templates are localized or clearly marked language-specific.
heuristics: H2 Match between system and real world

findings.criterion: Conditional form content matches selected inspection type
findings.title: Seal checks still ask for damage severity
findings.issue: Selecting Kiểm tra seal changes inspectionType toSEAL_CHECK, but the card keeps 'Biên bản Giám định Hư hỏng Hiện trường', a damage-specific placeholder and severity radios Nhẹ/Trung bình/Nặng. The selected severity is only included in notes for DAMAGE_SURVEY; therefore the displayed severity is irrelevant for seal/condition checks.

evidence.observed: Seal-check selected; damage title and severity remain.
Severity included only when type is DAMAGE_SURVEY.

findings.recommendedFix: Use a neutral inspection title/placeholder and render severity only for damage surveys.
findings.fixSnippet:
<Card title="Biên bản giám định hiện trường">
{inspectionType === 'DAMAGE_SURVEY' && <DamageSeverityField />}
</Card>
acceptanceCriteria: Seal and condition checks show relevant fields/copy only.
Damage surveys retain their current severity choices and submitted notes.
heuristics: H2 Match between system and real world

findings.criterion: Data lists distinguish loading, empty and failed states
findings.title: Inspection history starts with a false empty message
findings.issue: SurveyHomeScreen initializes rows=[] and has no loading state for yardApi.inspections(). Its history renders 'Chưa có biên bản giám định' whenever rows are empty, including while the request is pending or has failed; load errors appear in the creation form rather than next to history. This can imply that no inspections exist.

evidence.observed: load has no loading state or history retry.

findings.recommendedFix: Track history loading/error separately, display LoadingState or local ErrorState with retry, and show empty only after a successful response.
findings.fixSnippet: {historyLoading ? <LoadingState /> : historyError ? <ErrorState message={historyError} onRetry={load} /> : rows.length ? <InspectionList /> : <EmptyState title="Chưa có biên bản giám định" />}
acceptanceCriteria: Under a delayed GET, history shows loading rather than empty.
Under a failed GET, history shows a local retry; successful empty/populated results are distinct.

findings.criterion: Notification screen displays its available unread count
findings.title: Unread total is passed but never rendered
findings.issue: NotificationsScreen supplies subtitle 'Chưa đọc: ${unreadCount}', but AppHeader uses onBack ? title : ... and discards subtitle whenever a back action exists. Native notification headers show only 'Thông báo'; no unread total is displayed elsewhere on this screen.

evidence.observed: onBack suppresses subtitle; same result in dark.

findings.recommendedFix: Render the unread total inside the notification screen or add a dedicated subtitle line in AppHeader.
acceptanceCriteria: Native header/content shows the server unread count for zero and nonzero states.
Mark-read actions update the displayed count; verify with authorized fixture state.

findings.criterion: Date/time entry reduces format recall and invalid input
findings.title: Booking date requires a manually formatted timestamp
findings.issue: Booking form uses an unrestricted text field for the schedule. The required YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm syntax is explained only after review fails; the initial field presents one example with no persistent format helper or native date/time selection. Operators must type punctuation and remember the format.

evidence.observed: Plain text input Lịch thực hiện (giờ Việt Nam)*;example2026-10-02 09:30.
Required format appears only in validation message.

findings.recommendedFix: Offer date/time controls appropriate to the platform and retain an explicit UTC+7 helper; a minimal alternative is persistent format help plus input normalization.
findings.fixSnippet:
<Text style={styles.muted}>Định dạng: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm · giờ Việt Nam (UTC+7)</Text>
// Prefer a native date/time picker that formats the existing scheduledAt value.
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter a valid date/time without recalling separators.
Helper/timezone remains visible after entry and validation points to this field.

findings.title: Theme selection resets to light when the session reloads
findings.issue: ThemeProvider always initializes mode='LIGHT' with no persisted preference or system appearance fallback. The native app was dark before force-stop/reopen;84-session-reopened-light confirms the same ADMIN session returned with light appearance. Font-setting recreation also reset the choice.

evidence.observed: Reopened session in light;explicit Chuyển sang nền tối action.

findings.recommendedFix: Persist a selected appearance preference, initialize it before showing app content, and use system appearance when no preference is stored.
findings.fixSnippet:
const preferredMode = savedMode ?? (systemScheme === 'dark' ? 'DARK' : 'LIGHT');
// Save toggle changes to the existing preference storage; avoid a light flash during hydration.
acceptanceCriteria: Choose dark, close/reopen the app and retain dark with the existing auth session.
Initial unconfigured appearance follows the selected documented default/system preference.

findings.criterion: Validation messages remain accurate as input changes
findings.title: Missing-field error remains after both survey fields are filled
findings.issue: After blank review produces 'Nhập số container và nội dung ghi nhận', entering bothTCSU8849201 and Audit draft leaves the red missing-fields message until the next submit. The source onChangeText handlers do not clear/re-evaluate the validation state.

evidence.observed: Both fields populated, red missing-field notice still visible.
Notes populated while same notice persists.

findings.recommendedFix: Associate errors with individual fields and clear/re-evaluate missing-field errors on input edits without erasing server errors indiscriminately.
findings.fixSnippet:
onChangeText={(value) => { setContainerNo(value); clearFieldError('containerNo'); }}
// Use fieldErrors separately from request/history errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Blank review produces clear field-specific messages.
Filling each required field removes its missing-field error before another submit; server failures remain visible.
